notes: OpenLMIS v3 is an open-source electronic logistics management information system for public health supply chains; its API is a set of Spring Boot microservices behind one nginx gateway, all reachable under <host>/api. The project does not serve OpenAPI/Swagger anywhere (the demo gateway resets those requests and the old docs.openlmis.org API section is gone), but it does maintain a RAML 0.8 api-definition.yaml per service in GitHub — that is the machine spec used here. All 13 definitions (11 core services plus the two optional integration services) were captured verbatim as upstream-<service>.yaml and converted to one OpenAPI 3.0.3 document: 309 paths / 456 operations / 307 component schemas, versus the 20 paths the previous hand-authored subset covered. 'Full' here means every resource, method, query parameter and JSON body schema the 13 RAML files declare. Known fidelity losses of the conversion, all inherited from the upstream RAML: responses and request bodies that the RAML declares as application/json with no schema become an untyped object; RAML example blocks are not carried over; the resourceType placeholders (<<resourcePathName>>) used by the shared auditLog resource type survive literally in a few descriptions; and two schema files the RAML references (requisition schemas/statusMessageDto.json, fulfillment schemas/programOrderable.json) do not exist upstream, so they are modelled as untyped objects. Ten paths (service version endpoints such as /cce and /buq, the /hapifhir FHIR endpoints, and /localeSettings) sit at the gateway host root rather than under /api in the RAML; they carry a path-level servers override to say so. Draft-03/04 JSON Schema was normalised to OpenAPI 3.0 schema objects (per-property "required": true folded into parent required arrays, $schema/id dropped, relative schemas/*.json $refs resolved to components). Spring Data page envelopes keep the vendor's own {content, totalElements, totalPages, ...} shape, so list wrappers appear in data-schemas alongside the resources their detail endpoints return.
